Subject: SOC2 Type II report access request — evidence provenance & handling

Hi Jonas / Marissa,

FinTrak is preparing for our vendor security review and we'd like access to your SOC 2 Type II report and associated evidence package. Because this material is privileged for us, procurement will only accept a report handed over under an executed NDA.

A few asks up front so we can align on scope:
- Can Redwood share the Type II report and the evidence bundle (control narratives, sample testing artifacts, and SOX-related attachments) under a signed NDA?
- We have a strict evidence chain requirement — please confirm you can provide a chain-of-custody or manifest that lists files, timestamps, and a checksum (SHA256 or similar).
- Does Redwood provide a bridge letter if the report audit period doesn't exactly match our required window? If so, what does that cover?

Target timelines: procurement would like the NDA countersigned by EOD tomorrow (2028-03-02) and the report link provisioned within 24 hours of countersignature. Our procurement id: FT-93421.

Thanks — happy to set a short call if you prefer.

Best,
Lia Chen
Security Procurement Lead, FinTrak Inc.

Lia — thanks for the clear ask. We're set up to provide a gated report handoff under NDA. High-level process:

1) NDA: please review and countersign the attached standard confidentiality agreement (redwood_draft_nda_v3.pdf). We accept DocuSign or scanned signatures.

2) Evidence package: once we receive a countersigned NDA, we'll provision a time-limited S3 link containing: the Type II report PDF, evidence bundle (sample folders), a CSV manifest (soc2_chain_of_custody.csv) with file-level SHA256 hashes, and a small checksums file (redwood_soc2_package.sha256).

3) Audit period / bridge letter: we can provide a bridge letter that maps our audit window to the period you requested — it includes the auditor's statement of no material changes for the gap window.

4) Redaction & handling: we will redact third-party customer identifiers per our standard policy but will provide an index explaining redactions. If your legal team needs alternate handling, flag it now.

Attachments:
- redwood_draft_nda_v3.pdf (attached; editable)

If procurement needs us to upload to a different SFTP or a secure portal, we can accommodate that. Once you return the countersigned NDA I'll generate the package links and include the SHA256 checksum for verification.

I can also jump on a 15-min sync tomorrow morning to expedite.

Thanks,
Jonas Weber
Director, Strategic Security Partnerships
Redwood Inference

Lia — received the countersigned NDA and PO, thank you. Confirming next steps and a couple of clarifications:

- Receipt confirmed: FinTrak-signed-NDA-20280301.pdf is on file.
- Provisioning ETA: we'll upload the package and share a pre-signed S3 link within 24 hours (target by 2028-03-02 11:00 AM EST). The link will expire after 7 days unless you request an extension.
- Audit period: our current Type II report covers Apr 1, 2027 — Mar 31, 2028. That overlaps your requested Jan 1, 2027 — Dec 31, 2027 window but does not fully match it. We can provide a signed bridge letter from our auditor that attests to controls coverage for the gap period (Jan–Mar 2027). Please confirm whether a bridge letter is acceptable to FinTrak or if you require a report that strictly matches your calendar year window.
- Evidence provenance: the package will include soc2_chain_of_custody.csv with file-level metadata (filename, created_at, extracted_by, sha256). We'll also supply redwood_soc2_package.sha256 (manifest of hashes) so you can verify integrity after download.

I'll post the links and the SHA256 manifest to the HubSpot deal and send direct links in a follow-up email to procurement. For traceability, we will also record the handoff in our internal audit log and include the audit entry id in the email.

Preliminary delivery attachments (will appear in the link):
- redwood_soc2_package_20280302.zip (Type II report + evidence bundle)
- redwood_soc2_package.sha256 (SHA256 manifest)
- soc2_chain_of_custody.csv (file-level provenance manifest)

If FinTrak prefers a secure transfer to your SFTP instead of the S3 link, tell us the hostname and a username to provision.

Thanks — I'll follow up with the pre-signed link and the HubSpot record shortly.
